character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A bloated spitting creature for a 1990s American shopping mall horror roguelite. It was once a mall food court employee: a swollen low-slung body still wearing a grease-stained striped uniform shirt and an apron with NO lettering on it. The head is sunk low between the shoulders and a huge distended circular maw ringed with short blunt teeth takes up most of the face, held open. Sacs of fluid bulge along its back and glisten. One arm ends in a fused mass of drinking straws and cup lids. Short thick legs. POSTURE: hunched forward and top-heavy with the maw facing ahead, wider than a normal person and low to the ground. CRITICAL: the striped uniform and apron keep the food court worker recognisable. STYLE: detailed late-SNES pixel art, crisp hard pixels, clean deliberate clusters, selective outlines, minimal dithering, no anti-aliasing, no blur. LIGHTING: neutral overhead fluorescent mall lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
